# DiggerTerm v0.0.1

### 简体中文

首次 Windows x64 预览版：PowerShell / CMD / WSL 多会话终端，以及 GUI 退出后由后台 Daemon 保持会话。

下载 `DiggerTerm-v0.0.1-windows-amd64.zip`；SHA-256 校验值随 [校验文件](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.1/DiggerTerm-v0.0.1-windows-amd64.zip.sha256) 提供。

> Windows 程序尚未签名。SSH 与外部终端发现暂未实现。

### English

Initial Windows x64 preview: interactive PowerShell / CMD / WSL sessions, kept alive by a separate daemon when the GUI exits.

Download `DiggerTerm-v0.0.1-windows-amd64.zip`. SHA-256 checksums are provided in the [checksum file](https://github.com/xswt442-cmd/DiggerTerm/releases/download/v0.0.1/DiggerTerm-v0.0.1-windows-amd64.zip.sha256).

> This Windows build is unsigned. SSH and external-terminal discovery are not available yet.
